overview.description: The F/M Emerald Life Sciences Innovation ETF (LFSC) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in health care equity. The fund is an actively managed ETF that targets US health care and biotechnology companies identified to have promising life sciences opportunities. LFSC was launched on Oct 31, 2024 and is issued by F/m Investments.
